place.name: 台積創新館／新竹科學園區
place.nameEn: TSMC Museum of Innovation / Hsinchu Science Park
place.mapQuery: TSMC Museum of Innovation, No. 1 Li-Hsin 7th Road, Hsinchu, Taiwan

summary:
1987 年，台積電以專業晶圓代工模式成立，把替客戶製造晶片作為核心業務。這個故事不只關於一座工廠，更關於設計與製造如何透過規格、製程能力與交付品質協作。新竹的台積創新館提供理解這段產業分工歷史的公共窗口。

本課程從這個地點延伸到晶圓上一層層圖形與材料的形成：某道工序的輸出，會成為下一道工序的條件。地圖標示的是博物館與產業聚落的代表點，並非所有製程的唯一生產地；課程的分步模型也不是台積電未公開的製造配方。
summaryEn:
TSMC was established in 1987 around a dedicated foundry model, focusing on manufacturing customers’ chips. The story concerns more than a factory: it shows how design and manufacturing cooperate through specifications, process capabilities, and delivered quality. The TSMC Museum of Innovation in Hsinchu provides a public window into that industrial division of work.

The course extends this setting into the formation of successive material layers and patterns on a wafer. Each operation supplies conditions for the next. The map marks a museum and industry-cluster reference point, not the sole location of semiconductor production; the educational sequence is not TSMC’s undisclosed manufacturing recipe.

history.title: 專業晶圓代工模式起步
history.text: 張忠謀創辦台積電，專注於製造客戶的晶片，形成設計與製造分工的代表案例。
history.textEn: Morris Chang established TSMC with a focus on manufacturing customers’ chips, creating a prominent case of design–manufacturing specialization.

history.title: 創新館五週年
history.titleEn: The museum marks its fifth anniversary
history.text: 台積創新館發布五週年活動，顯示這段企業與半導體產業故事也透過公共展示傳承。
history.textEn: The museum announced fifth-anniversary activities, illustrating how this company and industry history is shared through public exhibitions.

connection: 以博物館認識產業分工，再回到課程比較微影、蝕刻、薄膜、平坦化與量測的前後依賴。練習區分「設計意圖」「製造結果」及「驗證證據」。
connectionEn: Use the museum to understand industrial specialization, then compare dependencies among patterning, etching, films, planarization, and measurement. Distinguish design intent, manufacturing outcome, and verification evidence.

references.title: 台積創新館交通位置
references.titleEn: TSMC Museum of Innovation: Getting Here

summary:
imec 於 1984 年在魯汶成立，其合作研究模式把晶片、材料、設備與設計的問題放在共同的研發環境裡討論。這使魯汶成為觀察先進製程如何從研究選項走向可驗證技術的代表地點，而不是某一家晶圓廠量產流程的替身。

2021 年的 imec 技術訪談把奈米片、forksheet 與後續元件構想連到接觸和金屬互連的挑戰。故事的重點是整合：元件變小，接觸電阻、佈線、材料與可靠度仍須共同改善。課程借此比較架構選項，不把研究路線圖當成已量產的共同配方。
summaryEn:
Founded in Leuven in 1984, imec brings device, material, equipment, and design questions into a collaborative research environment. Leuven is therefore a representative setting for studying how advanced-process options become experimentally testable technologies, rather than a substitute for one foundry’s production flow.

A 2021 imec interview connected nanosheets, forksheets, and later device concepts with contact and interconnect challenges. Its central lesson is integration: smaller devices still require progress in resistance, routing, materials, and reliability. This course compares architecture options without treating a research roadmap as a universal production recipe.

history.title: 魯汶合作研究中心成立
history.titleEn: A collaborative research center begins in Leuven
history.text: imec 在佛蘭德政府支持下成立，逐步發展與半導體產業共同研究的模式。
history.textEn: Imec was established with Flemish government support and developed a model of research collaboration with the semiconductor industry.

history.title: 元件與互連共同縮微
history.titleEn: Device and interconnect scaling are linked
history.text: imec 公開討論奈米片、forksheet、接觸與後段互連之間的共同設計需求，並報告可運作 forksheet 元件的電性研究。
history.textEn: Imec discussed coupled device, contact, and interconnect development and reported electrical research on functioning forksheet devices.

connection: 地圖連結研究園區；課程要求學徒把 GAA 元件截面、接觸、互連與量測結果放在同一張因果圖上，辨別概念、實驗展示及製造資格驗證。
connectionEn: The map anchors a research campus. Connect GAA cross-sections, contacts, interconnects, and measurements in one causal diagram, separating concepts, experimental demonstrations, and manufacturing qualification.

references.title: 兩奈米及以下邏輯技術縮微選項
references.titleEn: Logic Technology Scaling Options for 2nm and Beyond

place.name: ASML Veldhoven 園區
place.mapQuery: ASML, De Run 6501, 5504 DR Veldhoven, Netherlands

summary:
ASML 在 1984 年由 Philips 與 ASMI 共同創立，最初位於恩荷芬的一間簡陋廠房，隔年移入 Veldhoven 的辦公室與工廠。微影機的發展因此可以從一個實際的區域工程聚落講起：產品既需要原理突破，也需要能被組裝、校正及交付的系統。

2010 年，ASML 出貨首部 NXE:3100 預量產 EUV 系統；2013 年出貨首部 NXE:3300 生產系統。兩個節點提醒學徒，展示原理與滿足工廠使用要求之間仍有距離。Veldhoven 是研發與系統製造的代表園區，光學、光源及其他模組則涉及跨國合作與供應鏈。
summaryEn:
ASML was founded by Philips and ASMI in 1984, initially working from a modest building in Eindhoven before moving to offices and a factory in Veldhoven in 1985. Lithography therefore offers a place-based engineering story: a product needs both scientific advances and a system that can be assembled, calibrated, and delivered.

ASML shipped its first NXE:3100 pre-production EUV system in 2010 and its first NXE:3300 production system in 2013. These milestones distinguish demonstrating a principle from meeting factory requirements. Veldhoven represents research and system manufacturing, while optics, sources, and other modules involve international partners and suppliers.

history.title: ASM Lithography 成立
history.text: Philips 與 ASMI 建立新公司，同年推出 PAS 2000 微影步進機。
history.textEn: Philips and ASMI established the company, which introduced the PAS 2000 stepper that year.

history.title: 遷入 Veldhoven
history.text: ASML 從恩荷芬初期場址遷入 Veldhoven 新建的辦公室與工廠。
history.textEn: ASML moved from its initial Eindhoven location into new offices and a factory in Veldhoven.

history.title: EUV 從預量產走向生產系統
history.titleEn: EUV progresses from pre-production to production systems
history.text: 2010 年出貨 NXE:3100，2013 年出貨首部 NXE:3300，呈現系統工業化的不同階段。
history.textEn: Shipment of the NXE:3100 in 2010 and the first NXE:3300 in 2013 marked distinct stages of industrialization.

connection: 從園區回到光源、光學、真空、運動台與量測的介面圖；練習說明為何單一模組精度符合要求，仍不足以證明整機成像與對位表現。
connectionEn: Return from the campus to an interface diagram of source, optics, vacuum, stages, and metrology. Explain why a compliant module alone does not prove full-system imaging and overlay performance.

references.title: EUV 微影系統發展歷程

place.name: 日月光高雄園區（楠梓）
place.mapQuery: ASE Kaohsiung, No. 26 Chin 3rd Road, Nanzih, Kaohsiung, Taiwan

summary:
日月光於 1984 年在高雄開始第一座工廠的營運，之後把封裝與測試能力逐步整合。其歷史中的測試市場擴展與覆晶封裝量產，提供了一條從晶粒到可用電子元件的學習線索：晶圓製成後，工程工作並沒有結束。

本課程以楠梓的高雄園區作為代表地點，討論晶粒連接、散熱、機械支撐與測試如何共同決定封裝成效。地圖不代表所有先進封裝都在這裡製造；不同封裝架構與產品資格仍須分別驗證，也不能把企業里程碑當成每項產品的詳細流程。
summaryEn:
ASE began operations at its first Kaohsiung factory in 1984 and subsequently expanded the combination of assembly and test capabilities. Its entry into semiconductor testing and volume flip-chip packaging offer a path from a bare die to a usable electronic component: engineering does not end when wafer fabrication finishes.

The course uses the Kaohsiung campus in Nanzih as a representative place for studying electrical connection, heat transfer, mechanical support, and test. The pin does not imply that all advanced packaging is manufactured there. Different architectures and product qualifications remain separate, and corporate milestones do not disclose detailed product flows.

history.title: 高雄首座工廠營運
history.titleEn: The first Kaohsiung factory begins operations
history.text: 張虔生與張洪本創辦日月光，首座工廠在高雄開始營運。
history.textEn: Jason Chang and Richard Chang established ASE, whose first factory began operations in Kaohsiung.

history.title: 擴展半導體測試業務
history.text: 日月光透過收購 ASE Test Limited 進入半導體測試市場。
history.textEn: ASE entered the semiconductor test market through its acquisition of ASE Test Limited.

history.title: 覆晶封裝進入量產
history.text: 日月光歷史資料記錄覆晶封裝量產，提供比較打線與面陣列互連的歷史節點。
history.textEn: ASE’s history records volume flip-chip production, providing a milestone for comparing wire-bond and area-array interconnect approaches.

connection: 把高雄封測聚落連到課程的共同設計：在同一示意封裝中追蹤訊號、電源、熱量與機械應力，並指出每條路徑需要的驗證證據。
connectionEn: Connect the Kaohsiung assembly-and-test cluster to co-design: trace signals, power, heat, and mechanical stress through one illustrative package and identify evidence for each path.

place.name: AIM Photonics 測試、組裝與封裝中心
place.nameEn: AIM Photonics Test, Assembly and Packaging Facility
place.mapQuery: AIM Photonics Test Assembly and Packaging, 1964 Lake Avenue, Rochester NY 14615, USA

summary:
AIM Photonics 於 2015 年成立，其羅徹斯特測試、組裝與封裝中心在 2018 年成為重要的能力節點。這個選址把積體光子的研究接到羅徹斯特既有的光學與光子產業背景，也把「晶片畫得出來」與「光能可靠地接進接出」之間的落差放到眼前。

矽光子的故事不只在晶圓內。光纖連接、晶粒整合、量測與封裝會決定原型能否成為可驗證的系統。地圖標示 TAP 場址；AIM Photonics 在 Albany 也有相關活動，因此這裡代表封裝與測試的一環，並非整條產業鏈的唯一地點。
summaryEn:
AIM Photonics was established in 2015, and its Rochester Test, Assembly and Packaging facility became an important capability milestone in 2018. The location connects integrated photonics with Rochester’s optical-industry background and exposes the gap between designing a chip and coupling light into and out of a dependable system.

Silicon photonics extends beyond the wafer. Fiber attachment, integration, measurement, and packaging determine whether a prototype becomes a testable system. The map marks TAP; AIM Photonics also operates in Albany, so Rochester represents a packaging-and-test link rather than the entire chain.

history.title: AIM Photonics 成立
history.text: 2015 年 7 月的合作協議啟動研究機構，發展積體光子製造與人才能力。
history.textEn: A July 2015 cooperative agreement established the institute to develop integrated-photonics manufacturing and workforce capabilities.

history.title: 羅徹斯特 TAP 能力建立
history.text: TAP 中心的建立，將光子晶片的測試、組裝與封裝作為專門的共用研發能力。
history.textEn: The creation of TAP established dedicated shared development capability for photonic-chip testing, assembly, and packaging.

connection: 從地圖上的封裝中心回到耦光損耗、對準、調變、光偵測與熱漂移。練習區分晶片內部性能與封裝完成後的端到端光鏈路性能。
connectionEn: Link the packaging center to coupling loss, alignment, modulation, detection, and thermal drift. Distinguish on-chip performance from end-to-end performance after packaging.

place.name: NIST Gaithersburg 園區
place.mapQuery: National Institute of Standards and Technology, 100 Bureau Drive, Gaithersburg MD 20899, USA

summary:
網路安全沒有單一的製造工廠，因此本課程以 NIST 的 Gaithersburg 園區作為標準研究與公共知識的代表地點。NIST 在 2014 年發布 Cybersecurity Framework，協助組織用共同語言理解、降低及溝通風險。

框架於 2018 年更新，2024 年的 2.0 版再把適用對象明確擴展到各種組織，並新增治理功能。這段歷史提醒學徒：資安網路的建立不只是裝設備，還需要知道誰決策、要保護什麼、如何觀測事件，以及如何恢復。地圖是知識來源的定位，不是宣稱所有資安運作都集中於此。
summaryEn:
Cybersecurity has no single manufacturing factory, so this course uses NIST’s Gaithersburg campus as a representative location for standards research and public knowledge. NIST released the Cybersecurity Framework in 2014 to give organizations shared language for understanding, reducing, and communicating risk.

An update followed in 2018. Version 2.0 in 2024 explicitly broadened the audience to organizations of all types and added governance. The history shows that building a secure network involves decisions, assets, observation, and recovery as well as equipment. The map locates a knowledge source, not the entirety of cybersecurity operations.

history.title: 首版資安框架發布
history.titleEn: The first Cybersecurity Framework is released
history.text: CSF 1.0 提供組織化的風險管理語言，原始重點為關鍵基礎設施。
history.textEn: CSF 1.0 introduced structured risk-management language with an initial focus on critical infrastructure.

history.title: 框架更新為 1.1
history.text: NIST 發布 CSF 1.1，延續透過回饋修正框架的方式。
history.textEn: NIST released CSF 1.1, continuing an iterative development approach.

history.title: 2.0 納入治理
history.text: 2 月 26 日發布的 CSF 2.0 加入 Govern，並面向各產業與規模的組織。
history.textEn: CSF 2.0, released on February 26, added Govern and addressed organizations across sectors and sizes.

connection: 用 NIST 的六項功能檢查課程中的資產、身分、分區、日誌、事件處理及備援設計是否相互支援；框架是成果分類，不是保證安全的勾選表。
connectionEn: Use the six CSF functions to connect asset, identity, segmentation, logging, incident, and recovery work. The framework organizes outcomes; completing a checklist does not guarantee security.

place.name: Tesla Fremont 工廠
place.mapQuery: Tesla Fremont Factory, 45500 Fremont Boulevard, Fremont CA 94538, USA

summary:
Fremont 的故事是既有汽車工廠如何換上新的產品架構。Tesla 於 2010 年買下原 NUMMI 工廠，並在同年正式揭幕；2012 年 6 月 22 日，首批 Model S 在此交付客戶。這兩個時間點把場址取得、製造準備與真正交車分開。

電動車仍需要車身、裝配及品質驗證，但電池、電力電子、電機與熱管理改變了系統之間的關係。本課程以 Fremont 作為量產整合的代表案例，學習介面與可追溯性；不把這座工廠視為 Tesla 的全部產能，也不宣稱公開資料揭露完整製造參數。
summaryEn:
Fremont tells a story of an existing automotive plant adapted to a new product architecture. Tesla acquired the former NUMMI factory in 2010 and unveiled it that year; the first Model S customers received cars there on June 22, 2012. These dates separate acquiring a site, preparing production, and delivering vehicles.

Electric vehicles still need body manufacture, assembly, and verification, while batteries, power electronics, motors, and thermal management change system relationships. The course uses Fremont as a representative integration case, not Tesla’s entire production network or a source of undisclosed manufacturing settings.

history.title: 既有工廠轉為電動車生產基地
history.titleEn: An existing factory is adapted for electric vehicles
history.text: Tesla 於 5 月買下原 NUMMI 廠，10 月揭幕 Fremont 工廠。
history.textEn: Tesla purchased the former NUMMI plant in May and unveiled the Fremont factory in October.

history.title: 首批 Model S 交付
history.text: 6 月 22 日在 Fremont 工廠交付首批 Model S，讓產品開發與製造準備連到客戶使用。
history.textEn: The first Model S deliveries at Fremont on June 22 connected product development and production preparation to customer use.

connection: 在課程中把電池、逆變器、電機、冷卻與車身介面畫成系統圖；比較單件檢測與整車驗證，並追蹤版本、裝配紀錄及測試結果。
connectionEn: Map battery, inverter, motor, cooling, and body interfaces. Compare component checks with vehicle-level verification and trace configuration, assembly records, and test results.

place.name: 法拉利博物館／Maranello 製造聚落
place.mapQuery: Museo Ferrari, Via Alfredo Dino Ferrari 43, Maranello, Italy

summary:
1947 年 3 月，第一部掛上 Ferrari 名稱的 125 S 在 Maranello 試行。這個故事可以從引擎與底盤開始，卻不能只停在性能數字：零件製造、燃油供應、裝配與測試，都會決定一輛車能否把設計表現帶到道路與賽道。

地圖以 Maranello 的法拉利博物館作為公共的歷史入口，連結附近的製造聚落。2024 年揭幕的 e-building 則呈現另一段轉變：同一基地規劃容納內燃機、混合動力及電動車相關生產。這是多種動力系統與製造能力演進的案例，不是所有車款共用的組裝配方。
summaryEn:
In March 1947, the first car bearing the Ferrari name, the 125 S, was tested in Maranello. The story can begin with engine and chassis, but performance figures are insufficient: parts, fuel delivery, assembly, and testing determine whether a design works on the road and track.

The map uses Museo Ferrari as a public historical entry point to the nearby manufacturing cluster. The e-building inaugurated in 2024 represents another transition, designed to accommodate production associated with combustion, hybrid, and electric vehicles. This is a case of evolving powertrains and manufacturing capability, not one assembly recipe for every model.

history.title: 125 S 在 Maranello 試行
history.titleEn: The 125 S is tested in Maranello
history.text: 3 月 12 日，125 S 首次啟動並試行，成為 Ferrari 品牌歷史的重要起點。
history.textEn: On March 12, the 125 S was first started and tested, marking a formative moment in Ferrari history.

history.titleEn: The Maranello museum building is completed
history.text: 義大利文化部建築資料記錄博物館於 1990 年完成，將汽車與製造歷史引入展示空間。
history.textEn: Italy’s cultural-architecture record dates completion to 1990, bringing cars and manufacturing history into an exhibition setting.

history.title: e-building 揭幕
history.text: 6 月 21 日揭幕的新廠房，規劃支援內燃機、混合動力與電動車生產。
history.textEn: The new building inaugurated on June 21 was designed to support combustion, hybrid, and electric vehicle production.

connection: 從博物館的完整車輛反推引擎或電驅、底盤、熱管理與裝配介面；用零件公差、測試與故障證據解釋性能，而非僅以品牌或馬力評分。
connectionEn: Work backward from complete vehicles to powertrain, chassis, thermal, and assembly interfaces. Explain performance through tolerances, tests, and failure evidence rather than brand or horsepower alone.

place.name: 卡納維爾角 SLC-40 發射場
place.city: 卡納維爾角，佛羅里達州
place.mapQuery: Space Launch Complex 40, Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Florida, USA

summary:
2019 年 5 月，SpaceX 從卡納維爾角 SLC-40 發射一批 60 枚 Starlink 衛星。地圖選擇這個場址，是因為星系建設除了衛星製造，還需要把一批設備送入軌道，並在部署後逐一確認其狀態。這裡是代表性的發射地，不是 Starlink 衛星的製造工廠。

Starlink 的官方歷程將 2020 年列為服務上線的一年，提醒我們發射成功與形成可用通訊服務是不同里程碑。本課程把衛星、使用者終端、地面設施與網路交接放在同一系統圖中，討論覆蓋、延遲、容量與運維的取捨；不把單一地點或某年的統計當成整個星系的全貌。
summaryEn:
In May 2019, SpaceX launched a batch of 60 Starlink satellites from Cape Canaveral’s SLC-40. The map uses this location because building a constellation requires deployment and verification after reaching orbit as well as spacecraft manufacture. It is a representative launch site, not the satellite factory.

Starlink’s official history identifies 2020 as the year service went live, distinguishing launch success from usable connectivity. The course connects satellites, user terminals, ground facilities, and network handovers in one system diagram to examine coverage, latency, capacity, and operations. One location or one year’s statistics cannot describe the whole constellation.

history.title: 60 枚衛星的批次部署任務
history.text: 5 月 23 日美國東岸時間的 Starlink 任務從 SLC-40 升空；國際日期為 5 月 24 日 UTC。
history.textEn: The Starlink mission lifted off from SLC-40 on May 23 Eastern time, corresponding to May 24 UTC.

history.title: 服務上線
history.text: Starlink 的官方歷程把 2020 年列為服務上線年；發射、軌道部署與地面服務因此可分開討論。
history.textEn: Starlink’s official history identifies 2020 as its service-launch year, separating launch, orbital deployment, and ground service milestones.

connection: 由發射場切入批次部署與系統驗證，再回到低軌衛星、終端與地面網路的連接；練習分開發射成功、在軌可用及服務品質三種證據。
connectionEn: Use the launch site to introduce batch deployment and verification, then connect low-orbit satellites, terminals, and ground networks. Separate evidence of launch success, orbital availability, and service quality.
